description: Resource and data source address shapes the TypeScript parser rewrites to a reference key on the next regeneration (conformance/hcl/README.md, rule 21). The provider refuses every one of them with REF_EXPRESSION_REFUSED. An address of the same shape whose type is absent here (`<type>.<label>.arn` or `data.<type>.<label>.arn`) is refused with REF_SUGAR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, and names the refs key when the refs map binds that address; module aliases, lex bots, views, task templates, Cases templates and fields and Amazon Q in Connect assistants are key-form only. Every other expression is refused with REF_EXPRESSION_REFUSED, as is an address whose key refs or another address already binds to a different expression. The reference name is the inverse of slugIdentifier: a leading underscore is stripped only before a digit, underscores become hyphens, and the result must match the slug pattern.
refused: any address whose label is not a slug identifier
